fullPassage:
[주어진 글] That evening, I sat by the window and stared out at the empty field behind their house. Suddenly, I got an idea.

(A) With this plan in mind, the next step was to figure out the details. Before beginning your campaign, be sure to plan all the production details.

(B) The field would be the perfect place for a larger greenhouse. Then they could grow more strawberries! I would start a crowdfunding campaign!

(C) My grandparents were thrilled when I told them my idea. With the help of investors, we could build a large greenhouse and grow a lot more strawberries. Moreover, we could reward the investors by sending them jars of organic jam!

questions.passage: My grandparents sell their delicious organic jam at the local market every weekend. I went to help them last weekend. However, they had already <u>ⓐ sold</u> all of their jam! They didn't have enough strawberries <u>ⓑ to make</u> any more jam. That evening, I sat by the window and <u>ⓒ stared</u> out at the empty field behind their house. Suddenly, I got an idea. The field would be the perfect place for a larger greenhouse. Then they could grow more strawberries! I immediately started <u>ⓓ to search</u> for a way, and I found the perfect solution. I would start a crowdfunding campaign! My grandparents were <u>ⓔ thrilling</u> when I told them my idea.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 내가 아이디어를 말했을 때 조부모님은 매우 기뻐하셨다. 감정을 나타내는 분사에서 주어가 사람(감정을 느끼는 주체)일 때는 과거분사(-ed)를 사용합니다. thrilling(흥미진진하게 하는)은 사물 주어에 사용하는 현재분사이므로, 사람 주어인 My grandparents에는 thrilled(흥분한, 기뻐하는)로 고쳐야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: My grandparents were thrilling when I told them my idea.
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Crowdfunding is a way of (A) <u>[raising / to raise]</u> money for a product, company, or charity. These days, people can use crowdfunding websites to collect money. Crowdfunding is especially advantageous for individuals or small companies (B) <u>[that / what]</u> can't attract big investors. If the campaign is successful, the investors receive direct rewards for (C) <u>[they / their]</u> contribution.
questions.stem: 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 크라우드펀딩은 돈을 모으는 방법이다. 큰 투자자를 유치할 수 없는 개인이나 소규모 회사에 특히 유리하다. 투자자들은 그들의 기여에 대한 보상을 받는다.
det.analysis: 원문: a way of raising money... companies that can't attract... for their contribution.
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Before beginning your campaign, be sure <u>ⓐ to plan</u> all the production details. This planning is important because your potential investors will want to see a clear schedule. Once your plan is complete, remember <u>ⓑ setting</u> your funding goal. It should be enough <u>ⓒ to complete</u> the project and fulfill the rewards for the investors. <u>ⓓ Consider</u> all the necessary costs before deciding on the amount.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 자금 목표를 설정하는 것을 기억하세요. remember + to-v(앞으로 ~할 것을 기억하다) vs remember + v-ing(과거에 ~한 것을 기억하다). 아직 하지 않은 일을 잊지 말라는 의미 → to set이 적절.
det.analysis: 원문: remember setting your funding goal
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: With the help of investors, we could build a large greenhouse and grow a lot more strawberries. Moreover, we could (A) <u>[reward / punish]</u> the investors for their help by sending them jars of organic jam! After doing some calculations, we decided on an 8-by-12-foot greenhouse. We thought it would cost (B) <u>[approximately / precisely]</u> $4,000. We decided to set our funding goal at $5,000 to (C) <u>[cover / expose]</u> all the costs.
questions.stem: 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 투자자들에게 잼으로 보답할 수 있었다. 약 4,000달러가 들 것이라 생각했다. 모든 비용을 충당하기 위해 목표를 설정했다.
det.analysis: 원문: we could reward the investors... cost approximately $4,000... to cover all the costs.
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: For a successful crowdfunding campaign, ① <u>promoting</u> it is necessary. You should consider making a video. This allows investors to get to know you and learn about your product. In the video, describe your situation clearly and show your product. You also need to ② <u>express</u> how important the product is to you. Don't forget to include a ③ <u>direct</u> request for support at the end. During a campaign, it is important to send investors ④ <u>updates</u> every week. Through the update, the investors will be able to ⑤ <u>ignore</u> the progress of the campaign.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 투자자들이 캠페인 진행을 무시할 수 있을 것이다. 문맥상 track(추적/확인하다)이 적절, ignore(무시하다)는 반대 의미.
det.analysis: 원문: the investors will be able to ignore the progress
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: After our application was ① <u>accepted</u>, I was eager to make a good first impression with our investors. To ② <u>achieve</u> this, I made a video about my grandparents and their jam. In the video, I ③ <u>highlighted</u> how the strawberries were grown without using chemicals. I also included clips of my grandparents. In the clips, they were making the jam with ④ <u>artificial</u> ingredients. Finally, I explained where I wanted to put the new greenhouse and asked for ⑤ <u>support</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 인공적인 재료로 잼을 만들고 있었다. 유기농(organic) 잼이 핵심이며 chemical-free 강조 → artificial은 반대. 원문은 all-natural.
det.analysis: 원문: making the jam with artificial ingredients
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

det.tip: 대의 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
